patterns.note: Asymmetric two-column layout for hero and key call-to-action sections, often featuring a large, impactful image on one side and concise text on the other.
Prominent use of a large, elegant serif font for main headings and section titles, creating a sophisticated and editorial feel that contrasts with clean sans-serif body text.
Strategic use of a vibrant, warm yellow as a full-bleed background for a major call-to-action section, creating a strong visual anchor and high contrast with black text.

A two-tiered sticky navigation system where the primary navigation (logo, hamburger, search) is always sticky, and a secondary navigation bar (menu items) appears and also becomes sticky below it upon initial scroll.
Content sections are clearly delineated by large, expressive serif headings and often feature grid-based displays of content cards, primarily driven by high-quality photography.

technique_notes: A fixed header bar is present at the top of the viewport. Upon scrolling past the initial hero content, a second navigation bar slides in from the top and positions itself directly below the main header, both remaining sticky as the user continues to scroll.

Content sections are designed with a mix of full-width elements and asymmetric two-column layouts, where large, high-quality photography is paired with concise text blocks to create visual interest and hierarchy.
Information is presented in a clean, grid-based card format for listings, utilizing images as the primary visual entry point for each item, with minimal text overlays.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (often ~3-4x body size) with generous line height, paired with clean, legible sans-serif body and UI text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout for all elements like buttons, image containers, and content cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with significant vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, while content grids maintain a more consistent, tighter rhythm.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large, high-quality, often candid photography as a central design element, combined with a sophisticated, editorial-style serif typography for headings, creates a strong sense of artistic authority and visual richness that elevates it beyond typical museum sites. The bold, full-bleed yellow section also provides a memorable visual anchor.
